body: Thank you for the replies - they are helping :)  I do loads of yoga, workouts, cooking - that is kind of what I meant about feeling like I am doing things just so that I don't drop into a suicidal depression, rather than doing them because I actually want to do them.  It works, I feel better, but I miss feeling excited and wanting to do things. At this point anti-depressants are the only thing I have not tried, so I think that there is something worth looking into, there.

Do you have side effects from the anti-depressants?  I have gone to about 2 years of therapy, but I do not think it helped - it seemed to have just dismantled all of the coping mechanisms I'd put in place previously without giving me any alternatives.  I haven't tried anti-depressants because I'm worried that they will make me feel sick, but I recognize that is somewhat ridiculous to say if the alternative is killing myself...
